ideas.title: The Rise of Medicaid Fraud: A Deep Dive
ideas.description: Investigate the increasing trend of Medicaid fraud across the US, focusing on cases in Minnesota and California.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and analyze patterns of fraud
questions: What are the common patterns in Medicaid fraud?
How can these cases be prevented?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover systemic issues within the Medicaid system and potentially lead to policy changes
